subject: Order form redline: evidence snapshot scheduling + pen-test fallback plan
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@vitalcare.io>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: security@vitalcare.io
Date: 2026-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Contract questions — pen test timing and SOC2 snapshots

Thanks for sending the draft order form this morning, Mateo. A couple of asks from our side so we can keep procurement moving:

1) We need to lock a 2-week pen-test window in Q4 (we prefer mid-November). Who at Redwood will coordinate access and staking for that window?
2) Your team indicated you can provide SOC 2 snapshot evidence — can you confirm which syslog/retention artifacts you are prepared to share and the expected turnaround on those artifacts?

We don’t need live credentials in the initial phase — a snapshot and a short scope statement will suffice for our security review. Also attaching our vendor assurance checklist (referenced inline).

Alyssa
Director, IT Security
VitalCare Health

Attachment: vitalcare_assurance_checklist.pdf (referenced)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@vitalcare.io>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Contract questions — pen test timing and SOC2 snapshots

Alyssa — thanks, and great questions. Quick runbook below so we have a mutual action plan and a single place to track owners.

High-level answers:
- Pen-test window: we can commit to a two-week window in mid-November. Proposed dates: Nov 9–20 (targets a non-peak period for our infra). We’ll provision ephemeral staging access and a read-only console view for your testers during that window.
- SOC 2 snapshot evidence: we can provide the latest SOC 2 Type II summary report, sample control evidence (MFA logs, user provisioning events, change-control audit entries), and a sanitized system-event snapshot. Turnaround: we can deliver the snapshot package within 5 business days after a signed order form.

Next steps / owners (MAP):
- Mateo: confirm final order form redlines and provide the RF_OrderForm_redline_v1.pdf (attached).
- Neha (Security Ops): draft the evidence snapshot manifest + sample exports and confirm retention slices we can share.
- Karthik (Legal): review the fallback language for pen-test (timing, scope carveouts, and provider indemnities) and flag any MSA edits.

I attached a proposed MAP (MAP_vitalcare.docx) and a draft snapshot schedule (evidence_snapshot_schedule.xlsx). If legal is good with the fallback carveouts we proposed (see notes in RF_OrderForm_redline_v1.pdf), we can move to DocuSign and lock the pen-test dates.

Can Karthik confirm an expected legal turnaround? We want to keep procurement momentum.

— Mateo
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: RF_OrderForm_redline_v1.pdf, MAP_vitalcare.docx, evidence_snapshot_schedule.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-16T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Contract questions — pen test timing and SOC2 snapshots

Thanks — reviewed the redline and draft MAP. A few legal/contract items for clarity before we sign:

1) Pen-test fallback / timing: the redline proposes an explicit fallback to a 30-day alternative window if the primary dates are delayed. We should add a clause limiting repeated rescheduling (suggest: max 1 reschedule without written approval). Also need to specify whether penetration test artifacts (full report) are considered Confidential vs. Restricted — that affects retention and redaction requirements.

2) Evidence snapshot scope: confirm that the snapshot will be sanitized (PII redacted) and that export will include hashes for integrity. We need the evidence manifest to enumerate exactly which logs/events are included (e.g., MFA challenge logs, account creation, SR changes) — Neha, can you confirm the manifest fields and the expected CSV / syslog formats?

3) Audit rights language: suggest we push for a limited-scope inspection clause tied to SOC 2 attestations rather than unlimited on-site access. For customers in regulated spaces we can provide a bounded inspection (timeboxed + scoped), with escalation to legal for sensitive requests.

Timeline: I can produce a redline snapshot back to you all by EOD Friday (2026-09-17) if Neha can confirm the evidence manifest by EOD tomorrow. If we meet that timeline, Mateo: can you ask VitalCare to commit to the Nov 9–20 window in writing so procurement can reserve the slot?

Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@vitalcare.io>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, security@vitalcare.io
Date: 2026-09-17T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Contract questions — pen test timing and SOC2 snapshots

Alyssa — looping back with the updated plan and immediate asks so we can finalize next week.

Status update:
- Legal: Karthik will send the final MSA/order-form redline by EOD today (attached as RF_OrderForm_redline_v1.pdf with inline comments). He asked for a single customer confirmation about allowance for one reschedule; can you confirm VitalCare is OK with a maximum of one reschedule without escalation?
- Evidence manifest: Neha confirms we will provide MFA challenge logs (last 90 days), user provisioning CSV, and a sanitized event snapshot (timestamps + hash). Expected package delivery: 5 business days post-signature.
- Pen-test window: Please confirm Nov 9–20 in writing. Once confirmed, we will provision ephemeral staging and a read-only view for testers and create a short NDAs sub-document for test providers.

Action items for VitalCare (please reply inline):
1) Confirm acceptance of single reschedule cap (one allowed without escalation).
2) Confirm Nov 9–20 as pen-test window (or propose alternate 48-hour range).
3) Acknowledge evidence delivery timeline (5 biz days after order form signature).

If we get these confirmations by Wednesday (2026-09-22), Karthik and I will route the final order form to DocuSign and lock the pen-test slot. Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround here.

Best,
Mateo
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: RF_OrderForm_redline_v1.pdf (same file; legal comments inline), evidence_snapshot_schedule.xlsx (schedule), MAP_vitalcare.docx (mutual action plan)
